estimationGuidance.ambiguous: Report ambiguous-as-false-positive and ambiguous-as-true-positive bounds, plus an explicit non-ambiguous rate.
estimationGuidance.confidenceIntervals: Use Wilson or Clopper-Pearson intervals for sampled strata. Mark full-census strata separately rather than applying a sampling-error interval.
estimationGuidance.deleteOperationResource: Report separately as an audit stratum for possible strict-rule promotion; do not mix it into strict-cancellation estimates.
estimationGuidance.strictCancellation: Compute per-pattern rates and a pattern-family weighted estimate using populationFamilyMemberships. This estimates pattern-family membership precision, not unique-family prevalence over 407 families.
